results.title: East China refunds, Q3: public summary
results.content: East China's refund rate rose noticeably in Q3, mostly from mid-September, while North China and South China stayed in their normal range (b-101, b-103). Customer support saw many more refund requests there in September, and the most common complaint was being charged twice or being charged after a failed payment (b-207). The cause has not been confirmed and is still being investigated. Customers can request a refund within 30 days from the Orders page, and refunds go back to the original payment method in 5-7 business days (b-208).
